records.label: Overview
notes: OOC DEV armory rebaseline effective 244-BCE-07-23T10:22:48+08:00. Standing House Tang and Sword Manor fighting establishments are the aggregate issue baseline; exact named personal manifests remain separately owned.

Obsolete Sword Manor trainee heavy-lamellar, lamellar-helmet and medium-shield inventory was removed by explicit player-directed campaign rebaseline rather than treated as an in-world production or destruction event.

facts.issued aggregate calculation: House Tang fighting establishment 30,000 + Sword Manor fighting establishment 30,000. House Guard and all four Sword Manor ranks use long spear; Guardian Cavalry and Tang Champions use cavalry lance. Exact named personal manifests are separate custody owners and are not duplicated here.

facts.assigned mount calculation: Mount stock remains under its exact mount authorities and is not multiplied by this armory-only OOC rebalance.

facts.Bow conservation: 20,000 Composite Bow trainee loadouts + 5,000 Heavy War Bow junior-disciple loadouts + 35,000 Great War Bow House Tang/general/senior loadouts = 60,000 aggregate standing fighting loadouts; exact named personal manifests remain separate.
facts.Composite Bow calculation: 20,000 Sword Manor Initiates/trainees retain Composite Bows under the Tang-standard protective-kit rebaseline.
facts.Great War Bow calculation: 30,000 House Tang fighting establishment + 3,500 General Disciples + 1,500 Senior Disciples.
facts.separate exact-person bow manifests: owned by exact person/equipment custody records

facts.calculation: 60,000 aggregate standing bow loadouts x 36 carried arrows; strategic reserve mirrors the House Tang garrison-depot war-arrow stock and is not an additional second pile.

records.label: Ammunition
notes: Every aggregate standing bow loadout has one 36-arrow quiver. Reserve arrows are physically separate in the garrison depot and do not count as carried ammunition.
